verdict.rationale: Codegen's CLI lets you 'view agents, pull their work' and download branches/code changes to your local environment (codegen-docs-12,13), and Slack/Linear integrations let you interact with and redirect an agent mid-task via chat comments (codegen-docs-2,9,10). However there's no explicit documentation of an editor extension for takeover, nor a browser UI workflow for resuming/redirecting an in-progress task — only pulling completed work and prompting via chat/SDK. Missing for 10: editor-integrated takeover (e.g. VS Code/IDE plugin), documented browser-based 'resume this task' UI, and explicit mid-task redirect mechanics beyond chat messaging.
